paper_trading.note: Order submission (V1/engine/alpaca_trading.py) hardcodes TradingClient(paper=True) at the SDK level -- there is no live code path to accidentally hit. Env vars used: ALPACA_PAPER_API_KEY / ALPACA_PAPER_SECRET_KEY (V1's existing convention -- the ALPACA_API_KEY_PAPER/ALPACA_SECRET_KEY_PAPER names from the original task spec do not exist in this codebase and were not invented).

single_account_caveat: Only one Alpaca paper credential pair exists in V1/.env (ALPACA_PAPER_API_KEY/SECRET) -- one brokerage account. If two tracks hold overlapping tickers (likely, since IBS dominates both composite_v2 and composite_v3_1), real order submission through a single shared Alpaca account would net/commingle positions across tracks and make per-track P&L attribution impossible. Dry-run target-portfolio computation is unaffected (each track's signals/weights are computed independently), but --submit is NOT wired to actually call Alpaca until this is resolved -- see engine.py.
